description: PROFILE-ARGUMENT fixture for saga #811 (issue #816 item 6), half 1 of 2. This asserts CORRECT behaviour and must survive the fix UNCHANGED: `forward` genuinely is unavailable under `core-language` alone, so `ol-unknown-command` is the right answer to the question asked. What goes wrong in the field is the QUESTION, not the answer — asking it with a profile set that does not match the learner's environment is what makes an ordinary turtle program light up red, and that false positive was the documented reason `packages/studio/src/diagnostics.ts` defaulted `semanticCheck` to `false`, which is why checker output did not reach a learner as they typed. Issue #817 has since flipped that default, so the studio now runs the checker live under its own active profile set; this pair is what made that safe. Its sibling `forward-clean-with-turtle-profile` runs the SAME source with `turtle-rendering` added and asserts a clean result, so the pair proves the false positive is a profile-argument mistake rather than a checker gap — and stops it being re-introduced now that #817 has flipped that default.
